question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e. **'Sugest'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word in the options is** "Sugest".**
 
• The correct spelling is **"Suggest".**
 
• **"Suggest" **means to propose a solution, hypothesis or other possible answer.(सुझाव देना)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:** 'Sugest'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Healthy" **is spelled correctly. It refers to the state of being free from illness or injury.(स्वस्थ).
 
• **"Quantum"** is spelled correctly. In physics, "Quantum" refers to the discrete quantity of energy proportional in magnitude to the frequency of the radiation it represents.(क्वांटम).
 
• **"Mechanics"** is spelled correctly. It refers to the branch of physics dealing with the motion of and forces on objects.(यांत्रिकी).
